docText:
BUSINESS TRANSFORMATION REQUIREMENT DOCUMENT

Project Name:
Pani Puri Shop Online Ordering and Delivery Management System

Business Type:
Food and Beverage – Pani Puri Shop

Business Idea:
I want to open a Pani Puri shop and make the shop available for online ordering through food delivery platforms such as Swiggy. Customers should be able to discover the shop, view the menu, place an order, receive order notifications, and track their delivery.

BUSINESS OBJECTIVE:

The main objective is to digitally transform the Pani Puri shop so that customers can order food online instead of visiting the shop physically.

The system should help manage online orders, notify the shop when a new order is received, notify customers about order status, and provide live delivery tracking.

CURRENT BUSINESS PROCESS:

Currently, customers visit the shop physically and place their orders directly at the counter.

The shop does not currently have an online ordering system.

There is no automated order notification system.

There is no live delivery tracking system.

The business wants to start accepting online orders and provide delivery services.

PROPOSED ONLINE PROCESS:

1. Customer opens the food delivery application.

2. Customer searches for the Pani Puri shop.

3. Customer views the available menu items.

4. Customer selects Pani Puri and other available food items.

5. Customer selects quantity and adds items to the cart.

6. Customer confirms the delivery address.

7. Customer places the order.

8. The shop receives an instant notification about the new order.

9. The shop accepts or rejects the order.

10. If the order is accepted, the shop starts preparing the order.

11. The customer receives an order status notification.

12. After preparation, the delivery partner collects the order from the shop.

13. The delivery partner starts the delivery.

14. The customer receives a notification that the order is out for delivery.

15. The delivery partner's GPS location is shared while the delivery is active.

16. The customer can open the tracking screen and view the delivery partner's live location on a map.

17. The customer can see the estimated delivery status.

18. The delivery partner reaches the customer's location.

19. The order is delivered.

20. The customer receives a delivery completion notification.

CUSTOMER REQUIREMENTS:

The customer should be able to:

* Search for the Pani Puri shop.
* View the shop profile.
* View the food menu.
* View item names, prices and descriptions.
* Select food items.
* Select quantity.
* Add items to cart.
* View total order amount.
* Enter or select delivery address.
* Place an online order.
* Receive order confirmation.
* Receive order status notifications.
* View order history.
* Track an active delivery.
* View the delivery partner's live GPS location.
* View delivery status.
* Receive notification when the order is delivered.
* Provide feedback or rating after delivery.

SHOP OWNER REQUIREMENTS:

The shop owner should be able to:

* Create and manage the shop profile.
* Add menu items.
* Edit menu items.
* Remove unavailable menu items.
* Set item prices.
* View incoming orders.
* Receive instant notifications for new orders.
* Accept or reject orders.
* Update order status.
* Mark orders as preparing.
* Mark orders as ready.
* View delivery status.
* View active orders.
* View completed orders.
* View daily sales.
* View order history.
* Manage shop operating hours.

DELIVERY PARTNER REQUIREMENTS:

The delivery partner should be able to:

* Receive delivery assignment.
* Accept a delivery.
* View customer delivery address.
* View shop pickup location.
* Pick up the order from the shop.
* Start delivery.
* Share GPS location during active delivery.
* Update delivery status.
* Navigate to the customer location.
* Mark the order as delivered.

NOTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

The system should send notifications for important order events.

Customer notifications should include:

* Order placed.
* Order accepted.
* Order rejected.
* Order preparation started.
* Order ready.
* Order picked up.
* Order out for delivery.
* Delivery partner location available.
* Order delivered.

Shop notifications should include:

* New order received.
* Order cancellation.
* Delivery partner assigned.
* Delivery partner arriving for pickup.

Delivery partner notifications should include:

* New delivery assignment.
* Order ready for pickup.
* Customer delivery information.
* Delivery status updates.

LIVE GPS TRACKING:

The system should provide live GPS tracking when an order is out for delivery.

The delivery partner's current location should be periodically updated.

The customer should be able to open a tracking page and see:

* Delivery partner's current location.
* Customer's delivery location.
* Route between delivery partner and customer.
* Delivery status.
* Estimated delivery information.

GPS tracking should only be active while the delivery is in progress.

ORDER STATUS:

The order should have the following statuses:

PLACED
↓
ACCEPTED
↓
PREPARING
↓
READY FOR PICKUP
↓
PICKED UP
↓
OUT FOR DELIVERY
↓
DELIVERED

If the shop rejects an order, the status should become:

REJECTED

If the customer cancels an order where cancellation is allowed, the status should become:

CANCELLED

PAYMENT REQUIREMENTS:

The system should support online payment for customer orders.

Possible payment methods include:

* UPI
* Credit Card
* Debit Card
* Digital Wallet
* Cash on Delivery if supported

The payment status should be associated with the order.

ADMIN REQUIREMENTS:

An administrator should be able to:

* Manage shops.
* Manage users.
* Manage delivery partners.
* View orders.
* Monitor active deliveries.
* View order statistics.
* View payment information.
* Manage platform settings.
* Monitor system activity.

DATABASE REQUIREMENTS:

The system may require entities such as:

Customer
Shop
Menu Item
Order
Order Item
Delivery Partner
Delivery
Address
Payment
Notification
GPS Location
Review

Important relationships should be maintained between these entities.

For example:

Customer → Order

Order → Order Items

Order → Payment

Order → Delivery

Delivery → Delivery Partner

Delivery → GPS Location

Shop → Menu Items

Shop → Orders

TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS:

The proposed system should support:

* Web application.
* Mobile-friendly customer interface.
* Shop management interface.
* Delivery partner interface.
* Backend APIs.
* Database.
* Notification service.
* GPS/location service.
* Map integration.
* Payment integration.
* Food delivery platform integration.

POTENTIAL AI OPPORTUNITIES:

AI may be used for:

* Personalized food recommendations.
* Customer order recommendations.
* Demand prediction.
* Sales forecasting.
* Popular item prediction.
* Delivery time prediction.
* Customer feedback analysis.
* Automated customer support.
* Business insights.
* Inventory or ingredient demand prediction.

BUSINESS GOALS:

The system should help the Pani Puri shop:

1. Increase online orders.
2. Reach more customers.
3. Reduce manual order handling.
4. Provide faster order notifications.
5. Improve delivery visibility.
6. Improve customer experience.
7. Track business performance.
8. Support future business expansion.

EXPECTED OUTCOME:

The final solution should provide an integrated digital ordering and delivery management system for the Pani Puri shop.

The system should connect customers, the shop owner, delivery partners and administrators.

The solution should support online ordering, order management, notifications, delivery tracking, GPS location sharing, payment processing, business analytics and future AI-based improvements.

The proposed system should be scalable so that additional shops, menu items, delivery partners and customers can be added in the future.
